news.title: Staff Council book drive benefits local preschoolers
news.summary_en: Nineteen children at Fairview Elementary School in Bloomington received new books and other educational activities thanks to a book drive organized by the IU School of Education’s Staff Council.

news.title: Cuenca appointed to AACTE Board of Directors
news.summary_en: Alexander Cuenca, Associate Dean for Accreditation, has been appointed to the board for a three-year term starting next year. Cuenca said he is deeply honored to join the AACTE Board of Directors and grateful for the opportunity to serve an organization that plays such an important role in advancing educator preparation in the United States.
